understanding: Loopback staged traffic coordinates wishbone_bus THR writes to Receiver Buffer reads via internal return under virtual sequencer with serial_data and modem_control_if handles after t_uart_cfg t_wb_seq t_serial_seq t_modem_seq. DOCUMENTED authority is limited to LSR DR occupancy and IIR priority; MCR loopback control, THR RBR addresses, LCR divisor FIFO IER values and payload equality remain INFERRED guidance only and are referenced symbolically without invented values.
preconditions: AFTER t_uart_cfg symbolic LCR divisor FIFO-trigger IER programming completed via wishbone_bus after clock and reset bring-up
AFTER t_wb_seq plus t_serial_seq plus t_modem_seq sequencer handles available on shared virtual sequencer for coordinated spawn
Clock running at selected fixed period and reset released with polarity symbolic pending answer

Agents bound with RTL names for code: wishbone_bus drives wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i observes wb_dat_o wb_ack_o; serial_data drives srx_pad_i observes stx_pad_o; modem_control_if drives cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i observes rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o; uart_interrupt observes int_o
stimulus_steps: STAGE bringup: SPAWN virtual loopback_traffic on virtual sequencer with explicit handles to wishbone_bus plus serial_data plus modem_control_if; virtual spawns only, no VIFs or delays
FOR byte_index in 0 to SYM_loopback_count minus 1: SPAWN wishbone_bus write to SYM_THR with symbolic 8-bit payload; WAIT for write completion OR UNTIL TESTBENCH request_timeout_cycles expires

WAIT for Receiver Buffer arrival bounded by TESTBENCH timeout only; SPAWN wishbone_bus read of symbolic LSR then IF DR equals 1 SPAWN wishbone_bus read from SYM_RBR; FOR each transfer WAIT for completion
OBSERVE stx_pad_o via serial_data monitor and modem pins via modem_control_if monitor without asserting values; HOLD srx_pad_i at symbolic test-only idle via serial_data driver
check_steps: COMPARE LSR bit0 observed via wishbone_bus monitor against Receiver Buffer occupancy: EXPECT 1 when at least one character queued ELSE 0 [f_lsr_dr_1,f_lsr_dr_0]
IF uart_interrupt observes int_o pending THEN COMPARE IIR bit0 pending indication and bits 3-1 highest-priority code with stated source and reset control [f_iir_pending_1,f_iir_code_1]
coverage_steps: SAMPLE LSR DR occupancy from wishbone_bus monitor on THR or Receiver Buffer transfer: bins empty_0 versus queued_1
SAMPLE IIR pending and code from wishbone_bus monitor on IIR read: bins pending_0 versus idle_1 and modem_status versus thre_empty versus rx_data versus timeout versus line_status
completion: WAIT all spawned wishbone_bus children complete OR UNTIL TESTBENCH request_timeout_cycles expires as operational limit only
DRAIN wishbone_bus plus serial_data plus modem_control_if monitors for drain_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limit then close virtual sequence
CLEANUP deassert wb_stb_i and wb_cyc_i via wishbone_bus driver to symbolic idle, release explicit sequencer handles, leave serial_data and modem_control_if at symbolic idle

facts.statement: LSR bit 0 reports 1 when at least one received character is in FIFO.
facts.quote:
‘1’ – At least one character has been received and is in the
FIFO.

facts.statement: LSR bit 0 reports 0 when no characters in FIFO.
IIR bit 0 indicates interrupt pending when 0 and no interrupt pending when 1.
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR bits 3-1 report highest priority pending interrupt with stated source and reset control, including 011 Receiver Line Status.
facts.quote:
0 1 1 1 st Receiver Line
Status
Parity, Overrun or Framing
errors or Break Interrupt
Reading the Line
Status Register
